note: Hand-set coefficients, NOT fit on shadow data. This is a placeholder that lets the system produce a plausible, monotonic trust score from day one. It MUST be replaced by evals/calibration/fit_trust_score.py's output (spec §7.1) after 500+ shadow-mode (signals, correct/incorrect) pairs have been collected — see spec §14 P2 exit condition. Weights are deliberately NOT dominated by quote_source_in_topk/negation_consistent/quote_match_ratio alone: those are already separately hard-gated as booleans in router.py before trust is ever computed, so letting them alone push trust above t_auto would make the trust threshold check practically dead code for the auto-reply branch. Retrieval quality (rerank_top1/margin) carries the largest weight on purpose.
